## Description

SERVICE_CATALOGUE (name, category, code, SAC (IN) or CPT (AE), tax code, duration) with PRICE_VERSION (amount, currency, effective_from, optional payer price list), packages (items, sessions, validity, price). Editor with invoice line preview; saving creates a new price version effective from a date; archive instead of delete. Note "Tax treatment must be confirmed with your tax advisor".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Saving a price creates a new version; issued invoices keep the price version they were issued with (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** India services carry SAC and GST rate/exemption; UAE services carry CPT and VAT rate (5 % or zero-rated) per line.
- [ ] **AC3.** Payer-specific price lists override the default for insured patients (UAE).
- [ ] **AC4.** Packages define sessions and validity and are sellable from billing.
- [ ] **AC5.** Changes are audited; only admins can edit.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
